name: Search Records in Attio
description: Queries people, companies, or any custom object in Attio with optional filtering and sorting. Returns records with all attribute values.

object.description: Object slug or ID to search (e.g., 'people', 'companies', or a custom object slug)

filter.description: Attio filter object. See Attio filtering guide. Pass {} for no filter.

sorts.description: Array of sort objects. Each: { direction: 'asc'|'desc', attribute: 'slug' }.

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination

steps.name: Build query body with filter, sorts, and pagination
Format the response with extracted records
